title: A Layered Grammar of Graphics: ggplot2 methods
text:
In this chapter, you will learn the basic ideas behind ggplot2 and the main components used to build statistical graphics. You will also practise using these components to create data visualisations based on the layered grammar of graphics.
By the end of this chapter, you should be able to use the essential graphical elements in ggplot2 to produce clear and functional statistical graphics.

title: Beyond ggplot2 Fundamentals
text:
In this chapter, you will be introduced to several ggplot2 extensions for creating more elegant and effective statistical graphics. By the end of this exercise, you will be able to:

control the placement of annotation on a graph by using functions provided in ggrepel package,
create professional publication quality figure by using functions provided in ggthemes and hrbrthemes packages,
plot composite figure by combining ggplot2 graphs by using patchwork package.
